tasks.label: 发布: 清空 dist 文件夹
args: if (Test-Path dist) { Remove-Item dist/* -Recurse -Force; Write-Host 'dist 文件夹已清空' } else { New-Item dist -ItemType Directory | Out-Null; Write-Host 'dist 文件夹已创建' }
tasks.detail: 清空 dist 构建输出目录

tasks.label: 发布: 更新版本号
args: $v='${input:releaseVersion}'; $e=(Join-Path $PWD 'nebula\appfiles\embed.go'); $t=[IO.File]::ReadAllText($e); $i=$t.IndexOf('var Version string = '); $j=$t.IndexOf('"',$i); $k=$t.IndexOf('"',$j+1); $t=$t.Substring(0,$j)+'"'+$v+'"'+$t.Substring($k+1); [IO.File]::WriteAllText($e,$t,(New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $false)); $p=(Join-Path $PWD 'nebula\app\win\versioninfo.json'); $j2=[IO.File]::ReadAllText($p) | ConvertFrom-Json; $a=$v.Split('.'); $j2.FixedFileInfo.FileVersion.Major=[int]$a[0]; $j2.FixedFileInfo.FileVersion.Minor=[int]$a[1]; $j2.FixedFileInfo.FileVersion.Patch=[int]$a[2]; $j2.FixedFileInfo.ProductVersion=$j2.FixedFileInfo.FileVersion; $j2.StringFileInfo.FileVersion=$v; $j2.StringFileInfo.ProductVersion=$v; [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Resolve-Path $p),($j2|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10),(New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $false)); Write-Host '版本号已更新为 '$v
tasks.detail: 更新 embed.go 与 versioninfo.json 中的版本号

tasks.label: 发布: 重新生成 resource.syso
args: if (Get-Command goversioninfo -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Push-Location 'nebula\app\win'; goversioninfo -64; Pop-Location; Write-Host 'resource.syso 已重新生成' } else { Write-Host '未安装 goversioninfo，跳过（exe 文件版本信息保持旧值）' -ForegroundColor Yellow }
tasks.detail: 用 goversioninfo 重新生成 exe 版本资源

tasks.label: 发布: git 提交并打标签
args: git add -A; git commit -m 'release: v${input:releaseVersion}'; git tag -f v${input:releaseVersion}
tasks.detail: git add -A + commit + 打标签 v<版本>

tasks.label: 发布: 推送 GitHub + Gitee
args: if (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 7890 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { $env:HTTP_PROXY='http://127.0.0.1:7890'; $env:HTTPS_PROXY='http://127.0.0.1:7890' }; $b=git branch --show-current; git push origin $b; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 1 }; git push --force origin refs/tags/v${input:releaseVersion}; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 1 }; $tok=[Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('GITEE_TOKEN','User'); if (-not $tok) { Write-Host '未找到 GITEE_TOKEN，请先设置'; exit 1 }; git push --force "https://cjxpj:$tok@gitee.com/cjxpj/nebula.git" $b; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 1 }; git push --force "https://cjxpj:$tok@gitee.com/cjxpj/nebula.git" refs/tags/v${input:releaseVersion}
tasks.detail: 推送分支+tag 到 GitHub(origin) 与 Gitee（自动启用代理）

tasks.label: 发布: 创建 GitHub Release
args: if (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 7890 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { $env:HTTP_PROXY='http://127.0.0.1:7890'; $env:HTTPS_PROXY='http://127.0.0.1:7890' }; $gh='C:\Program Files\GitHub CLI\gh.exe'; $n='${input:releaseNotes}'; if (-not $n) { $n='Nebula v${input:releaseVersion} 发布' }; & $gh release create v${input:releaseVersion} dist/nebula.exe dist/nebula dist/nebula.apk --repo cjxpj/nebula --title v${input:releaseVersion} --notes $n
tasks.detail: gh 创建 GitHub Release 并上传 exe/linux/apk

tasks.label: 发布: 创建 Gitee Release
args: $tok=[Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('GITEE_TOKEN','User'); if (-not $tok) { Write-Host '未找到 GITEE_TOKEN，请先设置'; exit 1 }; $body=@{access_token=$tok; tag_name='v${input:releaseVersion}'; name='v${input:releaseVersion}'; body='${input:releaseNotes}'; target_commitish=(git branch --show-current)} | ConvertTo-Json; $rel=Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri 'https://gitee.com/api/v5/repos/cjxpj/nebula/releases' -ContentType 'application/json; charset=utf-8' -Body ([System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($body)); curl.exe -s -X POST "https://gitee.com/api/v5/repos/cjxpj/nebula/releases/$($rel.id)/attach_files" -F "access_token=$tok" -F 'file=@dist/nebula.exe'; curl.exe -s -X POST "https://gitee.com/api/v5/repos/cjxpj/nebula/releases/$($rel.id)/attach_files" -F "access_token=$tok" -F 'file=@dist/nebula'; curl.exe -s -X POST "https://gitee.com/api/v5/repos/cjxpj/nebula/releases/$($rel.id)/attach_files" -F "access_token=$tok" -F 'file=@dist/nebula.apk'
tasks.detail: Gitee API 创建 Release 并上传 exe/linux/apk
